ReviewProbe.Scope: QR photograph recovery, all three integration points, semantic extraction, sampling precision, deadlines, cancellation, acceptance, pool lifetime, deduplication and test-fixture provenance

ChangedDecoders: Modern QR pixel recognition retries one small-image finder triple using local normalization, hybrid thresholding and existing full perspective sampling before broad threshold/transform work. The retry requires plausible primary finder geometry, at most 900 pixels per dimension and at most twelve candidates; it retains the caller deadline and tight dimension list. Original result collection, framing/ECC/payload validation and profile selection remain. No public API or production dependency is added. Collection, finder sampling and jitter code now use semantic partials.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 188/267 correct positive images versus 187/267 in the previous pass. Previously correct images lost: none; gained: qrcode-3/11.png. Paired negative completion is [30, 29, 30, 31]/31 with the current binary and [30, 30, 30, 30]/31 with the previous qualified binary. All outcomes remain sensitive to shared-host contention and wall-clock budgets; no universal timeout or recognition advantage is established. A bounded early QR photograph retry uses existing normalization, hybrid thresholding and perspective precision within the same configured allowance. This changes modern QR recognition search order; acceptance checks and deadlines remain unchanged. A demonstrated regression gain does not establish accuracy on unseen photographs, and legacy fallback is unchanged. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. The invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracle and undeclared QR character encoding policies remain unchanged in scoring. Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported.

RegressionProof.Coverage: An unmodified independently encoded shaded-perspective photograph through single QR, multi-result QR and scanner public APIs with a 600 ms recognition allowance. A clean independent warmup avoids testing cold JIT speed. Existing multi-symbol, artwork, API parity and nested-deadline contracts remain covered. Legacy fallback is unchanged and retains its regression suite.

RegressionProof.HistoricalProof: Prior sampling, orientation and PDF417 proof remains historical in previous-qualification.json. Current full suites and frozen/supplemental outcomes are rerun.
